licence.summary: Crown/HKSAR Government copyright, not an open licence. Ireland.language_authenticity: English is not the only authoritative language. Under Article 25.4 of the Constitution (text checked on eISB at /eli/cons/en/html), where the President signs a Bill in only one official language, an official translation is issued in the other. Where both texts are enrolled and conflict, 'the text in the national language shall prevail'; the national language is Irish. In practice, almost all modern Acts, including every one listed here, are signed in English, which makes English the authoritative signed text and the Irish version an official translation. Irish-language versions exist, or are due, and some older Acts were signed in Irish, in which case the Irish text is authoritative.

acts.notes: Regulates private occupational retirement funds. The two-pot system came in through the 2024 amendments.

acts.title: Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act 4 of 2002
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act 4 of 2002'. Commencement: 1 April 2002 (Gazette 23284). Amended as recently as Revenue Laws Second Amendment Act 44 of 2024.
acts.notes: Sets the 1% employer plus 1% employee UIF contribution, collected by SARS through payroll.

acts.title: Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act 130 of 1993
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act 130 of 1993'. Commencement: 1 March 1994. Amended by Act 10 of 2022 and by National Health Insurance Act 20 of 2023.
acts.notes: No-fault employment injury insurance funded by employer assessments.

acts.title: Social Assistance Act 13 of 2004
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Social Assistance Act 13 of 2004'. Commencement: 1 April 2006, except Chapter 4, which commenced on 1 April 2021 (Gazette 44299). Amended by Act 16 of 2020.
acts.notes: Covers the older person's, disability, child support, foster child, care dependency and war veterans grants and social relief of distress.

acts.title: South African Social Security Agency Act 9 of 2004
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'South African Social Security Agency Act 9 of 2004'. Commencement: 15 November 2004, with s 4 on 1 April 2006.
acts.notes: Sets up SASSA, the agency that administers and pays grants. It is institutional, so secondary to the Social Assistance Act.

acts.title: Income Tax Act 58 of 1962
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Income Tax Act 58 of 1962'. Commencement: 1 July 1962. Amended as recently as Revenue Laws Amendment Act 6 of 2025.
acts.notes: The Fourth Schedule sets up PAYE withholding by employers. Rates change each year through Rates and Monetary Amounts Acts.

acts.title: Tax Administration Act 28 of 2011
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Tax Administration Act 28 of 2011', with an objects summary and no repeal tag. Amended by Tax Administration Laws Amendment Acts, per the search results.
acts.notes: Covers returns, assessments, objections and appeals, penalties and interest.

acts.title: Insurance Act 18 of 2017
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Commencement: 1 July 2018 (GG 41735, GN 639). It 'replace[s] certain parts of the Long-term Insurance Act, 1998, and the Short-term Insurance Act, 1998'. The repeal of LTIA ss 48, 52, 53, 56, 59, 60 and STIA ss 46, 47, 51, 53, 54 was excluded from that commencement. Amended by Act 23 of 2021. The Gazette PDF says 'English text signed by the President'.
acts.notes: Prudential regulation and microinsurance. It replaced the prudential parts of the STIA and LTIA, which remain in force for market conduct and policyholder protection (policyholder protection rules).

acts.title: Short-term Insurance Act 53 of 1998
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Short-term Insurance Act 53 of 1998'. Commencement: 1 January 1999. Amended by Insurance Act 18 of 2017 and Financial Sector Regulation Act 9 of 2017. It is amended, not repealed.
acts.notes: Kept for conduct of business and policyholder protection. The Policyholder Protection Rules made under it govern claims handling. Long-term Insurance Act 52 of 1998 is the life-insurance counterpart; it is on gov.za at /documents/long-term-insurance-act but was not separately detailed here.

acts.title: Road Accident Fund Act 56 of 1996
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Road Accident Fund Act 56 of 1996'. The page notes commencement of s 10 on 21 April 1996 and amendments up to National Health Insurance Act 20 of 2023. There is no repeal tag.

acts.title: Local Government: Municipal Systems Act 32 of 2000
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Local Government: Municipal Systems Act 32 of 2000', with an objects summary. The search results list its amendments, including Act 3 of 2022. There is no repeal tag.
acts.notes: Chapter 8 covers tariff policy (s 74) and Chapter 9 covers customer care, credit control and debt collection for municipal electricity and water accounts. Most household utility billing is municipal.

acts.title: Electricity Regulation Act 4 of 2006
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Electricity Regulation Act 4 of 2006', with commencement from 1 August 2006. The search results show Electricity Regulation Amendment Act 38 of 2024.
acts.notes: Covers NERSA licensing and tariff regulation.

acts.title: Water Services Act 108 of 1997
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Water Services Act 108 of 1997', and the objects include 'norms and standards for tariffs'. Amended by Act 30 of 2004. There is no repeal tag.
acts.notes: Covers the basic water right, tariff norms and the conditions for limiting or discontinuing water services (s 4).

acts.title: Carriage by Air Act 17 of 1946
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Carriage by Air Act 17 of 1946'. Commencement: 22 March 1955. Amended by Carriage by Air Amendment Act 15 of 2006. There is no repeal tag.
acts.notes: Gives effect to the Warsaw/Montreal regime on carrier liability for passenger injury, delay and baggage, and extends it to domestic carriage. South Africa has no EU261-style statutory compensation for delay or denied boarding.

acts.title: Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008', with an objects summary including the establishment of the National Consumer Commission. There is no repeal tag.
acts.notes: Also applies to fixed-term agreements, including some leases (s 14).

acts.title: Rental Housing Act 50 of 1999
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Rental Housing Act 50 of 1999'. Commencement: 1 August 2000. The page mentions Rental Housing Tribunals and lease requirements. Amendment Acts 43 of 2007 and 35 of 2014 appear in the search.

acts.title: Customs and Excise Act 91 of 1964
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Customs and Excise Act 91 of 1964'. Commencement: 1 January 1965, with s 58A on 1 April 2021. Amended as recently as Rates and Monetary Amounts Amendment Act 45 of 2024.
acts.notes: This is the operative customs statute. It stays in force until the Customs Control Act and the Customs Duty Act commence.

acts.title: Immigration Act 13 of 2002
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Immigration Act 13 of 2002'. Commencement: 20 February, 26 February and 12 March 2003 (all sections except s 37). Amended by Immigration Amendment Act 8 of 2016 among others.
acts.notes: Covers visas, including the work visas in ss 19 and 21, permanent residence and employer duties (s 49).

acts.title: Employment Services Act 4 of 2014
acts.verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Employment Services Act 4 of 2014'. Commencement: 9 August 2015 (GG 39079). Its objects include facilitating 'the employment of foreign nationals'.
acts.notes: Sections 8 and 9 regulate the employment of foreign nationals by employers. gov.za lists a 2026 Employment Services Amendment Bill that has not been enacted.

topic_gaps.reason: The only statutory coverage is carrier liability under the Carriage by Air Act, plus general Consumer Protection Act remedies. There is no dedicated statute for air, rail or bus passengers covering compensation for delay, cancellation or denied boarding. Any rules of that kind sit in civil aviation regulations or technical standards, not in primary legislation.

South Africa.language_authenticity: English is not the only authoritative language in principle. Constitution s 82 (checked in the justice.gov.za PDF 1996-108.pdf) says 'The signed copy of an Act of Parliament is conclusive evidence of the provisions of that Act.' Acts are gazetted bilingually, English plus one other official language that rotates (Afrikaans, Tshivenda, Sepedi and others), and only the signed text is conclusive. In practice the signed text is English: the Gazette PDFs checked for Act 9 of 2018 and Act 18 of 2017 both say '(English text signed by the President)'. Older Acts, especially before 1994, were sometimes signed in Afrikaans, so the signed language should be checked Act by Act on the Gazette copy. For the Constitution itself, s 240 makes the English text prevail. The Interpretation Act 33 of 1957 (justice.gov.za 1957-033.pdf) was searched for a signed-text rule and none was found; the s 82 rule is the operative one.
problems: gov.za is an as-passed archive with commencement and amendment notes, not a consolidated register with an 'in force' flag. 'In force: yes' rests on a recorded commencement, recent amendments listed and no [repealed] tag.
For consolidated text, gov.za points to SAFLII. SAFLII was deliberately not accessed.
Customs Control Act 31 of 2014 and Customs Duty Act 30 of 2014: no commencement proclamation was found. The Legal Data Hunter MCP returned a rate-limit error, so their status is 'unverified'.

Licence: gov.za's terms allow only non-commercial use. Copyright Act 98 of 1978 s 12(8)(a) is generally understood to exclude official legislative texts from copyright, but this was not verified from an official source. A human should decide whether canon can rely on s 12(8)(a) or needs GCIS permission.
The Road Accident Fund Act page on gov.za lists commencement for s 10 only, so its commencement record is incomplete.
The Long-term Insurance Act 52 of 1998 is on gov.za and was only amended by the Insurance Act, but its detail page was not fetched.
